The '''Sphere of Military Offense''', also known as the '''Ministry of Military Offense''', the '''Pyramid of Military Offense''', and the '''Office of Military Offense''', was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Headed by a [[Dark Council]]or, the Sphere was responsible for directing the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] on campaigns of conquest, and the [[Sphere of Military Strategy]] advised the Sphere on matters of strategy.

==History==
[[Darth Vengean]] was succeeded as head of the Sphere by [[Darth Baras]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. With the [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Galactic War)|death]] of Baras by the hands of the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], [[Darth Arho]] inherited the Sphere and was responsible for the [[Battle of Ilum|assault]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> By [[3637 BBY]], [[Darth Arkous]] held the position on the Council, but was secretly a [[Order of Revan|Revanite]]. His machinations culminated in the [[Assault on Tython|assault]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] before being [[Raid on Rakata Prime|defeated]] on [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]] in the [[Revanite crisis|campaign]] against the Revanites. 

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the sphere was combined with the [[Sphere of Defense of the Empire|Spheres of Defense of the Empire]] and Military Strategy into the [[Sphere of Military Command]] by Empress [[Darth Acina]].<ref name="SOTG" />
